item.title: 'No Entry' sign facing the wrong way. It is the right-hand of a group of three similar signs telling drivers not to enter the upper part of Montpellier Street, Cheltenham but is actually facing the Queens Hotel (ie, eastwards), suggesting no entry to Fauconberg Road. This is likely to confuse drivers who do not know the area. It should be facing the same way as the other two 'No Entry' signs, ie roughly southwards. It may have been twisted on the post by vandals., 19th September
item.description:
At the staggered crossroads formed by Montpellier Street / Queens Circus / Fauconberg Road, Cheltenham. * Diagonally opposite St Andrews Church, Montpellier. * Rear corner of bar at 131-133 The Promenade, Cheltenham. * This post has no number on it, but it is next to post No 110322. * What3Words = swim.guitar.plug

item.title: Pigeon problem Under the bridge, 19th September
item.description:
The netting under the Honeybourne bridge on market street was removed because it was falling down one end and birds where getting trapped, it was also filling with rubbish, it looked much better. However the pigeons are now nesting and perching on the ledges under the bridge and causing a right mess. There is a thick layer of poo on the path and down the bridge walls, there are feathers starting to block the drain. We can’t park under the bridge as cars are covered with poo, walking under the bridge it is also risky trying not to get pooped on. It all looks very messy and is not very hygienic. It may need spikes attaching to the ledges to deter the birds. Thank you in advance.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Market Street, Wymans Brook, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
